newsitem.title: PERU: Bus crash in Peruvian Andes kills at least 10.
newsitem.headline: Bus crash in Peruvian Andes kills at least 10.

text.p: A bus plunged into a ravine in the Peruvian Andes on Tuesday, killing at least 10 of the estimated 60 passengers crammed on board, authorities said.
The bus careened off a winding mountain highway, plummeted 490 feet (150 meters) down a precipice, nose-diving into the riverbed below, firefighter Hildebrando Rodriguez told Reuters.
Another 40 passengers were injured in the accident in the Huancavelica area near the town of Acostambo, some 300 miles (480 km) east of Lima, Rodriguez said.

Authorities said they would have a more precise death-toll once they began pulling bodies out of the river. They concentrated initial rescue efforts on transporting survivors by train to hospitals in the nearby town of Huancayo.
The bus had been completely full after picking up passengers in a nearby mining village, according to police officials.
